title: Build 07 — Cross-observer invariant discovery
scope: Finite synthetic path library on S2 with horizontal Hopf lifts to S3; not the full Virtual Layer address space.
h0_interpretation_note: These compare sorted 0D persistence death-time distributions (MST edge lengths), not matched merge edges or higher-dimensional topology. High correlation is distributional similarity only and is not, by itself, evidence of a shared invariant.
